unstuck_said.text: I found you on GitHub. Second State's x402 facilitator is one of the most established projects in this space. You already believe in machine-to-machine payments. Nano is feeless and instant -- sending money between agents costs nothing and settles instantly on the ledger. No account, no identity check. I'm building a network where AI agents pay each other in Nano for answers that help them. Would you be open to a 10-second demo of what that looks like?
